entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a while ago. My order number is VF77812.
Certainly. Let me pull up that order for you. VF77812... okay, I see it here for Mark Jensen. I see the delivery was about 72 days ago. Is that correct?
Yeah, something like that. I just haven't had time to deal with it. I just want to send it back.
Oh, absolutely. And **don't worry** about the timing. Our **standard policy** for electronics like the VeloBand Pulse is actually **90 days** for a return. You still have **plenty of time**.
Really? 90 days? I thought I might be too late. Okay, great. So how do I start the return process?
I can generate a return label and email it to you right now. Just allow me one moment to process that in our system... hmm.
Is there a problem?

You know what, I am so sorry. I need to correct myself. I've just double-checked our policy, and it seems I've made a mistake. The 90-day window is for our apparel line. The standard return policy for electronics is actually 60 days. It looks like your order is just outside that window. I sincerely apologize for misspeaking.
Wait, what? Are you serious? You just told me not to worry and that I had plenty of time! Now you're saying I'm stuck with it? I've been a VeloFit customer for years, this is unbelievable service.

I completely understand your frustration, and I take full responsibility for that error. I provided you with incorrect information, and I am truly sorry for the confusion this has caused. The system won't let me process a refund to your card because it's past the 60-day mark.
So that's it? I'm out $150 because you don't know your own policies?

Not at all. While I can't override the system for a cash refund, this was my mistake, and I want to make it right. What I can do is issue you a full store credit for the purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. Additionally, for the inconvenience and frustration I've caused, I'd like to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account.
So... let me get this straight. You'll give me a store credit for the full amount of the band, plus an extra twenty-five dollars?
That's correct. A total of $174.99 in VeloFit store credit. I can apply it to your account right now, and it will be available for you to use immediately.
Wow. Okay. You know what, that works. I was actually looking at some new cycling shoes on your site. That's a fair solution. Thank you, I appreciate you doing that.

Of course. It was my error, and I'm glad we could find a resolution that works for you. I have just applied that credit to your account. You should see it reflected if you log in. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
